findings.evidence: Lines 92–97 impose only `ContinuousAmbientIsotopic knot.knot pushOff` and disjoint ranges. The roadmap reference `gs-kirby-calculus.md:35` defines framing as an identification of the normal bundle with `S¹ × ℝ^(n−1)` and notes its isotopy classes form a torsor under `π₁(O(n−1))`.
findings.fix: Represent framing by a normal-bundle trivialization or framed tubular embedding; if using push-offs in dimension three, require a parallel section inside a specified tubular neighborhood, and ensure link-component push-offs avoid the whole link.
findings.issue: `FramedOrientedSmoothKnot` accepts any disjoint knot ambient-isotopic to the original; such a component may wander outside every tubular neighborhood (for example, components of a nontrivial two-component link) and is not a normal framing. In arbitrary ambient dimension, one push-off also cannot encode a trivialization of the higher-rank normal bundle.

summary: The framing field does not encode a normal framing or even a genuine parallel push-off, so the default knot and link presentations misrepresent their claimed geometric data.
